series.name: 2021 AUX portable A/C codes (E1/E3/E4/E8/P1)
series.notes: Portable A/C section of the 2021 AUX troubleshooting guide (E1/E3/E4/E8/P1). High (service manual). Portable product line — digits collide with split meanings, never merged (separate file).

title.en: Portable unit internal temperature sensor error
title.ur: Portable unit ke internal temperature sensor ki kharabi

meaning.en: The portable unit's main control panel detects the internal room sensor as short-circuited or open.
meaning.ur: Portable unit ka main control panel internal room sensor ko short-circuited ya open parh raha hai.

causes.en: Room sensor resistance out of range, shorted or broken
causes.ur: Room sensor ki resistance out-of-range, short ya tooti hui hai

causes.en: Damaged sensor wire, loose terminal or damp at the connector
causes.ur: Sensor wire kharab, terminal dheela ya connector par geela pan hai

solutions.en: Measure the sensor - nominally about 15 kohm at 25 C for inverter models
solutions.ur: Sensor measure karein - inverter models ke liye 25 C par nominal taqreeban 15 kohm hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Dry and re-seat the connector; if the code follows a borrowed sensor, replace the sensor
solutions.ur: Connector ko sukha karke dobara lagaayein; agar code udhar se laya gaya sensor ke sath bhi aata hai to sensor badal dein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX) - Portable A/C

notes.en: Form factor is portable/mobile air conditioner. The manual warns against fitting a sensor of the wrong value, which skews the sensed temperature and causes start or shutdown errors.
notes.ur: Yeh portable/mobile air conditioner hai. Manual ghalat value wala sensor lagane se mana karta hai, kyunke us se sensed temperature bigad jata hai aur start ya shutdown ke errors aa jate hain.

title.en: Portable unit internal coil sensor error
title.ur: Portable unit ke internal coil sensor ki kharabi

meaning.en: The main control panel detects the internal coil sensor as short-circuited or open.
meaning.ur: Main control panel internal coil sensor ko short-circuited ya open parh raha hai.

causes.en: Coil sensor failed, damp or disconnected
causes.ur: Coil sensor fail ho gaya, geela hai ya disconnect hai

causes.en: Damaged lead or a fault on the main control panel
causes.ur: Lead kharab hai ya main control panel par fault hai

solutions.en: Measure the sensor against its nominal value and dry the connector
solutions.ur: Sensor ko us ki nominal value ke saath compare karke measure karein aur connector ko sukha kar lein.

solutions.en: Substitute a known-good coil sensor, then attend to the panel if the code stays
solutions.ur: Known-good coil sensor lagayein, aur agar code bhi rahe to panel theek karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX) - Portable A/C

notes.en: Form factor is portable/mobile air conditioner. Nominal reference given as 5 kohm or 20 kohm at 25 C.
notes.ur: Yeh portable/mobile air conditioner hai. Nominal reference 25 C par 5 kohm ya 20 kohm diya gaya hai.

title.en: Portable unit lower DC motor error
title.ur: Portable unit ke neeche wale DC motor ki kharabi

meaning.en: The control panel is not receiving the fan speed feedback from the lower DC motor.
meaning.ur: Control panel ko neeche wale DC motor se fan ki speed ka feedback nahi mil raha.

causes.en: Motor stuck by foreign matter, or the internal speed-feedback element failed
causes.ur: Motor kisi bahri cheez se atka hua hai, ya andaruni speed-feedback element fail ho gaya hai

causes.en: Fault in the speed feedback receiving circuit on the main control panel
causes.ur: Main control panel ke speed feedback receiving circuit mein fault hai

solutions.en: Clear anything jamming the fan and re-seat the motor terminal
solutions.ur: Fan ko jam karne wali cheez hatayein aur motor terminal dobara lagaein.

solutions.en: Swap in a known-good DC motor - if the code remains the panel is at fault, otherwise replace the motor
solutions.ur: Known-good DC motor lagayein - agar code bhi rahe to panel kharab hai, warna motor badal dein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX) - Portable A/C

notes.en: Form factor is portable/mobile air conditioner. The manual gives a five-lead colour/voltage test procedure and warns that the red lead carries 310 V DC.
notes.ur: Yeh portable/mobile air conditioner hai. Manual 5 leads wala colour/voltage test procedure deta hai aur warn karta hai ke laal lead par 310 V DC aata hai.

title.en: Portable unit display board communication failure
title.ur: Portable unit display board ki communication kharabi

meaning.en: The display board lost contact with the main control panel, so it shows no reliable state.
meaning.ur: Display board ka main control panel se contact poori taraf toot gaya hai, is liye yeh koi sahi halat nahi dikhata.

causes.ur: Connection line dheela ya kharab hai

causes.en: Failed display board or failed main control panel, or an unmatched pair
causes.ur: Display board ya main control panel fail ho gaya, ya dono matched pair nahi hain

solutions.en: Re-seat or replace the connection line and restart
solutions.ur: Connection line dobara lagaein ya badal dein aur restart karein.

solutions.en: Fit a known-good panel; if E8 persists replace the display board, and replace both if they do not match
solutions.ur: Known-good panel lagayein; agar E8 bhi raha to display board badal dein, aur agar dono match nahi karte to dono badal dein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX) - Portable A/C

notes.en: Form factor is portable/mobile air conditioner. Manual repeats the matched-pair warning for display board and main control panel.
notes.ur: Yeh portable/mobile air conditioner hai. Manual display board aur main control panel ke liye matched-pair warning dohrata hai.

title.en: Portable unit water tank full alarm
title.ur: Portable unit ke water tank bharne ka alarm

meaning.en: The unit reports that the condensate tank is full, or the float switch is stuck, and stops.
meaning.ur: Unit batata hai ke condensate tank bhar gaya hai ya float switch atak gaya hai, aur ruk jata hai.

causes.ur: Water storage tank waqai bhara hua hai

causes.en: Float switch stuck open or closed, or an abnormal main control panel
causes.ur: Float switch khula ya band atka hua hai, ya main control panel abnormal hai

solutions.en: Open the drain plug at the rear, drain the tank completely, then switch the unit off and back on
solutions.ur: Peeche wala drain plug kholein, tank poori tarah khali karein, phir unit band karke dobara on karein.

solutions.en: Check the float switch operates freely and reads correctly on a meter, replacing it if it is stuck
solutions.ur: Check karein ke float switch azaadi se chalta hai aur meter par sahi reading deta hai; agar atka ho to switch badal dein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX) - Portable A/C

notes.en: Form factor is portable/mobile air conditioner. Manual notes the alarm usually clears by itself once the water is drained; only then replace float switch or panel.
notes.ur: Yeh portable/mobile air conditioner hai. Manual ke mutabiq pani nikal jane ke baad alarm aksar khud clear ho jata hai; uske baad hi float switch ya panel badlein.
